Phase 1 scans all 20 slots and resets any slot whose expiry float is not the -1.0f sentinel (0xBF800000) and is older than the value dbl_8AFEA8, while recording the first empty slot index and the last non-empty slot index. Phase 2, when a gap exists before the last non-empty slot, shifts each later non-empty slot leftward into the nearest preceding empty slot (StructCopy) and resets the vacated slot (StructInitWithSentinelValues). Called by TextOverlayDisplayTimer (0x004186F0).

operations.description: Reads v1 = dbl_8AFEA8 and initializes v3 (first empty index) and v4 (last non-empty index) to -1.
Phase 1 loop: iterates 20 slots (indices 0..19) of the 32-byte slot array at this+537, stepping v6 by 8 dwords; slot 0 starts at field 0x864.

Per-slot expiry guard: the slot's dword[3] float (offset +0xC, e.g. 0x870 for slot 0) must not equal the -1.0f sentinel value -1082130432 (0xBF800000) and v1 (current time) must be greater than that float value.
StructInitWithSentinelValues(slot) resets an expired slot to its empty/default state.
Slot id test: when the slot's first dword equals -1 (0xFFFFFFFF) it is empty and v3 records the first such index; otherwise the slot is non-empty and v4 records its index.
Phase 2 runs only when there is at least one non-empty slot (v4 != -1) and a gap exists before the last non-empty slot (v3 < v4).
Compaction loop: scans slots from index 1 to 19 through the cursor v2 (starting at this+537, stepping 8 dwords); slot 1's id field (0x884) is read here.
On finding an empty slot (*v2 == -1), a forward inner scan locates the next non-empty slot (j); if the scan reaches index 20 the function returns early.
StructCopy(empty_slot, next_nonempty_slot) copies the filled slot's 32 bytes into the gap.
StructInitWithSentinelValues(next_nonempty_slot) resets the vacated source slot to its empty/default state.
Implicit return: exits when the forward scan in Phase 2 finds no non-empty slot to fill the gap.

functions.name: ObjectComparisonWithTiebreak
functions.summary: Two-entry comparator. Null a1/a2 are handled by returning the other entry. Reads the primary sort key at offset 0x19C of each entry; when a2's key is larger than a1's the function returns a1, and when a2's key is smaller it returns a2. functions.name: HighestScoringConstructorResolver
functions.summary: Resolves the constructor team with the highest championship-points score. Allocates an 8-byte [name, score] object via OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper (name=0, score=-1), then loops over the 14 constructor team name strings (Arrows, BAR/off_5C25E0, Renault, Ferrari, Jaguar, Jordan, McLaren, Minardi, Prost, Sauber, Williams, Toyota, Benetton, Stewart). For each team the name is staged through StringCopyWithBufferRealloc and scored with ChampionshipPointsAccumulator(&byte_5EA438, -1). A candidate beats the current best when its score is higher and (if a1 is non-null) it passes the sub_566810 filter; the best name is committed via StringCopyWithBufferRealloc(&byte_5EA438) and its score saved. If a2 is non-zero, returns the [name, score] object immediately; otherwise a second identical 14-team pass detects ties: if any team's score equals the stored best, returns 0. Falls through to return the object when no tie is found.

Initialize the object: *v4 = 0 (name), v4[1] = (char*)-1 (score).
If allocation failed, v10 = 0; otherwise v10 = v4.

First pass: do/while v5 in 0..13, dispatch via jump table jpt_41F385; each case stages the corresponding constructor name (aArrows, off_5C25E0, aRenault, aFerrari, aJaguar, aJordan, aMclaren, aMinardi, aProst, aSauber, aWilliams, aToyota, aBenetton, aStewart) through StringCopyWithBufferRealloc.
v6 = ChampionshipPointsAccumulator(&byte_5EA438, -1); compute the championship-points score of the team currently staged in byte_5EA438.
If v11 < v6 AND (a1 is null OR sub_566810(&byte_5EA438, a1) returns false), the candidate is the new best: commit its name via StringCopyWithBufferRealloc(&byte_5EA438) and set v11 = v6.
If a2 is non-zero, return v10 immediately after the first pass (no tie-check).
Second pass (only when a2 == 0): infinite loop dispatching v7 0..13 via jump table jpt_41F465, staging each constructor name through StringCopyWithBufferRealloc exactly as the first pass.

Tie detection per candidate: v8 = *v10 (stored best name), or &byte_5EA438 when the stored pointer is null; if sub_566810(v8, &byte_5EA438) is false (names equal) AND v11 == ChampionshipPointsAccumulator(&byte_5EA438, -1), return 0 (another team ties the best score).
After all 14 second-pass teams, return v10 (the [name, score] object of the highest-scoring team).
